reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but daily skipping is independently orchestrated in shared scheduling, both handlers, and budget templates.

duplication.why: The daily skipping decision is repeated across four consumers, and the two date handlers duplicate their filtering and adjustment pipeline.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but recurrence policy also leaks into server handlers and budget calculation.

scope.why: The edits remain focused on the requested scheduling rules, range handler, supporting types, tests, and release note.

maintainability.why: Centralized holiday matching helps, but scattered daily dispatch and independently chosen occurrence search bounds make future scheduling changes harder to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts implements daily skipping separately in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange instead of sharing the policy implemented by shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-frequency and skipWeekend decision appears as a find operation in getFirstWeekdayOccurrence, filters in both handlers, and an inverted noSkipWeekend argument in budget/schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: Holiday input is added to getDateWithSkippedWeekend and WeekendRule; getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, while both date handlers and the budget template separately implement daily-policy dispatch.
